title: VisceralFit exercise catalogue
description: Schema for app/src/main/assets/exercises_seed.json. The Kotlin wire format is data/seed/ExerciseSeeder.kt (ExerciseCatalogue / SeedExercise), parsed with ignoreUnknownKeys=false, so an unrecognised field is a hard failure at seed time rather than a silently empty field. Authoring standard: framework/08_exercise_library_spec.md.

version.description: Catalogue version. Increment on every content change; the seeder upserts when this exceeds the lowest seed_version in the exercises table. Not a schema version.

id.description: Stable slug, modality-prefixed. NEVER renamed once shipped: session history and favourites reference it.

name.description: What a competent instructor would call it. Use the established Pilates name where one exists.

modality.description: Must match a Modality.id in domain/model/Modality.kt.

difficulty.description: See spec §2. When in doubt, rate it harder: a beginner served an intermediate movement is inconvenienced; the reverse is a hazard.

met_value.description: From framework/data/met_values.json, with its Compendium code. Never invented.

how_to.description: Ordered steps, one action each. Setup before movement. Must be complete enough to perform correctly with no video (REQ-041). State the endpoint, not just the direction.

spoken_instruction.description: One sentence read aloud at segment start. Must finish inside the shortest interval this exercise can appear in — roughly 14 words for a 30 s interval (REQ-044). Say it aloud and time it.

safety_notes.description: The specific failure mode, not generic caution. Anything with met_value >= 8.0 must include a stop-if-symptoms note (REQ-006).

common_mistakes.description: What actually goes wrong, and ideally why it matters.

muscles_worked.description: Plain names, not Latin. Primary movers first.

illustration_id.description: Key into core:designsystem's drawing registry. May reference a drawing that does not exist yet; the placeholder handles it (REQ-046). Reuse where the position is genuinely identical.

caution_tags.description: Closed set — the settings UI enumerates it. Do not invent tags. Tag generously: a false positive costs one exercise, a false negative costs an injury.

is_per_side.description: True when the movement is bilateral-alternating and should be cued per side.

evidence_keys.description: Keys from framework/data/references.md. NEVER a key that is not in that file — the validation test parses references.md and checks.
